en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a long, two‑storey historic brick building along a wide tree‑lined street. A tramcar runs on tracks in front of the building and horse‑drawn carriages travel on the road. The facade has many evenly spaced windows and a central entrance. Trees and lampposts line the sidewalk, with a park or wooded area on the right. Red printed text at the top identifies Budapest and the building as an imperial and royal military food supply depot in Hungarian and German; a small red number is printed at the bottom left.
